sql: SELECT profile.city AS city, COUNT(*) FROM records GROUP BY profile.city ORDER BY city ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT SUM(profile.detail.zip), COUNT(profile.detail.zip), AVG(profile.detail.zip) FROM records
SELECT record_id, COALESCE(profile.detail.zip, 0) + 1, LOWER(profile.city) FROM records WHERE profile.detail.zip BETWEEN 1 AND 99999 ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT r.record_id, r.profile.city, r.profile.detail.zip FROM records r WHERE r.profile.city = 'NY' ORDER BY r.record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT record_id, profile.detail.zip FROM records WHERE profile IS NULL OR profile.detail IS NULL ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records WHERE NOT (profile.detail.zip > 100000) AND profile.city IN ('LA', 'NY')
SELECT profile.detail.zip AS zip, SUM(record_id), COUNT(*) FROM records GROUP BY profile.detail.zip HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY zip ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT DISTINCT profile.detail.zip AS zip FROM records ORDER BY zip ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT record_id, profile.detail.zip AS zip FROM records ORDER BY zip DESC NULLS LAST, record_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 5
SELECT record_id, CASE WHEN profile.city IS NULL THEN 'missing' ELSE UPPER(profile.city) END, COALESCE(profile.detail.zip, -1) FROM records ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT record_id, CARDINALITY(samples) FROM records WHERE CARDINALITY(samples) >= 1 ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT COUNT(profile), COUNT(profile.detail), COUNT(samples), COUNT(*) FROM records
SELECT record_id, profile FROM records ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT record_id, items, samples, matrix, large_values FROM records ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT record_id, profile IS NULL, profile.detail IS NULL, samples IS NULL FROM records ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT record_id, CASE WHEN record_id > 2 THEN samples ELSE NULL END, COALESCE(NULL, profile) FROM records ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
SELECT record_id, profile, samples FROM records WHERE record_id < 0 ORDER BY record_id
